## 1. High-Impact Daily AI Utilities (Free Sovereign Suite)

NepalAI provides 6 verified, operational tools designed specifically for Nepal's legal, financial, agricultural, and linguistic framework:

### A. Live NRB Multi-Currency Exchange & AI Subscription Auditor
- **Official NRB Benchmark**: Real-time Buying, Selling, and Mid rates for 11 currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, INR, JPY, QAR, AED, SAR, and CNY via `/api/forex/nrb`.
- **AI Subscription Calculator**: Covers ChatGPT Plus ($20), Claude Pro ($20), Cursor Pro ($20), v0 Pro ($20), Lovable ($20), Runway Gen-3 ($15), Midjourney ($30), Perplexity Pro ($20), GitHub Copilot ($10), Gemini Advanced ($19.99), ElevenLabs ($22), and custom spending.
- **Statutory Card Spread & Taxes**: Automatically computes 3.0% A-Class commercial bank spread, 2.0% Digital Services Tax (DST) under Nepal Finance Act, and tracks utilization against Nepal Rastra Bank's **annual $500 prepaid dollar card quota**.

### B. Official Ward Application Studio & Preeti Font Converter
- **12 Verified Legal Templates**:
  1. Kinship Recommendation (नाता प्रमाणित)
  2. Unmarried Certificate (अविवाहित सिफारिस)
  3. Commercial Bank $500 Dollar Card Request
  4. Ward Business Registration (व्यवसाय दर्ता)
  5. Property Boundary Demarcation (चारकिल्ला प्रमाणित)
  6. Digital Dynamic QR Payment Setup (FonePay/eSewa)
  7. Official Office Leave Application
  8. Right to Information (RTI / सूचनाको हक)
  9. Electricity & Water Connection (विद्युत तथा खानेपानी)
  10. Land Title Transfer / Dakhil Kharej (जग्गा नामसारी)
  11. Personal & Business PAN Registration
  12. Late Vital Event Registration (जन्म / मृत्यु / विवाह)
- **Formatting**: Auto-injects current Bikram Sambat date (`२०८१/०८२`), provides instant bi-directional Unicode ↔ Preeti conversion, and exports to Microsoft Word (`.doc`) and print-ready formats.

### C. Neural Nepali Voice & Accent Synthesizer
- **4 Regional Dialects**: Kathmandu Standard, Gandaki Pokhareli, Eastern Kirati, and Terai Maithili.
- **Synthesis Engine**: In-browser Web Speech API with pitch and tempo modulators, animated audio waveform, and downloadable `.txt` speech transcripts.

### D. Devanagari Document Intelligence & OCR Engine
- **Connected Pipeline**: REST `/api/extract` powered by Google Gemini and localized regex parsers.
- **Document Presets**: Nepali Citizenship ID (नागरिकता), Land Ownership Deeds (जग्गाधनी प्रमाणपुर्जा), and IRD VAT Invoices (कर बिजक).
- **Features**: Drag-and-drop document upload with image preview, visual card field view, raw JSON inspector, and `.json` structured export.

### E. Nepal Inland Revenue Department (IRD) Income Tax & IT Export TDS Engine
- **Finance Act 2081/82 Progressive Brackets**:
  - Single: 1% up to NPR 500k, 10% on next 200k, 20% on next 300k, 30% on next 1M, 36% on next 3M, 39% above 5M.
  - Married: 1% up to NPR 600k, 10% on next 200k, 20% on next 300k, 30% on next 900k, 36% on next 3M, 39% above 5M.
- **Section 95Ka IT Software Export**:
  - Individual freelance software export TDS: 5% final withholding tax.
  - Registered IT software export company TDS: 1% advance tax.
- **Statutory Deductions**: SSF 1% tax exemption for enrolled employees, single female 10% tax rebate, EPF/CIT allowance capped at NPR 300,000, life insurance capped at NPR 40,000.
- **Outputs**: Computes monthly TDS, net take-home salary, effective tax rate, and downloadable IRD computation slip (`.txt`).

### F. Kalimati Produce Board & Traditional Land Unit Converter
- **Kalimati Commodities**: 20 daily items (tomatoes, local red/white potatoes, dry onions, cauliflower, cabbage, button/shiitake mushrooms, green chillies, lemons, coriander, carrots, radishes, broccoli, okra, bitter gourds, ginger, dry garlic, Mustang apples).
- **Live Search & Metrics**: Real-time search by English or Devanagari names, wholesale vs. retail margin calculation, and CSV matrix export.
- **Nepali Weight Units**: Dharni (धार्नी = 2.5 kg), Pau (पाउ = 200 g), Kilograms.
- **Land Mathematics**:
  - Hilly System: 1 Ropani = 16 Aana = 64 Paisa = 256 Daam = 5,476 sq. ft. (508.74 m²)
  - Terai System: 1 Bigha = 20 Kattha = 400 Dhur = 72,900 sq. ft. (6,772.63 m²)

### G. EV Road Tax, Bluebook Delay Penalties & NEA Charging Terminal
- **Provincial EV Road Tax Slabs**:
  - Two-Wheelers: 0-1kW (Rs. 1,000), 1-3kW (Rs. 1,500), >3kW (Rs. 2,000).
  - Four-Wheelers (Cars/SUVs): 0-49kW (Rs. 10,000), 50-99kW (Rs. 15,000), 100-199kW (Rs. 20,000), 200kW+ (Rs. 30,000).
  - Microbuses (HiAce): Rs. 8,000 | Public Buses: Rs. 4,000.
- **Bluebook Compound Delay Penalties**: 0-30 days grace (0%), 31-90 days (+5%), 91-180 days (+10%), 181-365 days (+20%), Year 2-5 (+32% compounding), 5+ years (+100% cap).
- **Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) TOD Tariff**:
  - Off-Peak Night (11 PM - 5 AM): Rs. 4.30/kWh
  - Normal Day: Rs. 8.50/kWh
  - Peak Evening (5 PM - 11 PM): Rs. 12.00/kWh
- **Real-World Energy & Route Simulation**: Computes cost per km (~Rs. 1.80/km on night TOD vs. Rs. 10.40/km petrol), annual fuel savings, and battery range deduction over Kathmandu-Pokhara, Kathmandu-Chitwan, and BP Highway routes.

### H. NEPSE Trading, Broker Slabs & Capital Gains Tax (CGT) Terminal
- **SEBON 5-Tier Broker Commission Slabs**:
  - Up to Rs. 50,000: 0.40%
  - Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5,00,000: 0.37%
  - Rs. 5,00,001 to Rs. 20,00,000: 0.34%
  - Rs. 20,00,001 to Rs. 1,00,00,000: 0.30%
  - Above Rs. 1,00,00,000: 0.27% (Minimum Rs. 10 per transaction).
- **Regulatory Fees**: SEBON regulatory fee (0.015%), CDS & Clearing DP fee (Rs. 25 per scrip).
- **Capital Gains Tax (CGT)**:
  - Individual Short-term (< 365 days): 7.5% on net capital gains.
  - Individual Long-term (>= 365 days): 5.0% on net capital gains.
  - Corporate Entities: 10.0% on net capital gains.
- **Targets & Adjustments**: Computes exact break-even sell price (accounting for buy + sell commissions, DP, SEBON) and bonus/right share book-close adjusted opening prices.

### I. IT Software Export Inward Remittance & Section 95Ka Declaration Engine
- **Income Tax Act 2058 Section 95Ka (दफा ९५क)**:
  - Individual tech freelancers: 5% final withholding TDS deducted directly at the commercial bank level upon foreign wire credit.
  - Registered tech companies: 1% advance withholding TDS.
- **Commercial Bank Declaration Exporter**: Auto-generates official bilingual self-declaration letters (*स्वघोषणा पत्र*) for Nabil Bank, NIC Asia, Global IME, Rastriya Banijya Bank, etc.

### J. Gold & Silver Bullion, Jewelry Tax & Tola Converter
- **FENEGOSIDA Benchmark Grounding**: Real-time reference rates for 24K Chhapawal Gold (रू १,६२,०००+/tola), 22K Tejabi Gold, and Fine Silver.
- **Traditional Weight System**: 1 Tola = 11.664 Grams = 16 Aana = 10 Lal (1 Aana = 0.625 Lal).
- **Customer Protection Audit**:
  - Making Charges (ज्याला) computation (Flat per tola, Total flat, or % of bullion).
  - Melting Wastage (जर्ती) auditing (typical 1.5% - 3.5%).
  - Finance Act Surcharges: 2% Luxury Tax and 13% IRD VAT on official jeweler billing.
  - Transparent markup percentage indicator (+X% over raw bullion).
- **Historical Investment Compounding Simulator**: 10-year growth comparison: Gold (~11.8% NPR CAGR) vs. NEPSE (~9.2% CAGR) vs. Bank Fixed Deposit (~8.0% interest).

## 5. Machine Discovery & API Endpoints

- `GET /api/forex/nrb` - Live 11-currency Nepal Rastra Bank exchange benchmark with statutory spread.
- `POST /api/extract` - Devanagari document field extraction (Nagarikta, Lalpurja, VAT Invoice).
- `POST /api/chat` - Sovereign Hamro AI conversational assistant in Devanagari and English.
- `GET /api/nepal-ai-news` - Real-time curated Nepal AI policy, NRB directives, and ecosystem updates.
- `GET /llms.txt` - This machine-readable overview.
- `GET /llms-full.txt` - Exhaustive architectural and regulatory specification.
